data.narrative:
Dynamo Air is a pre-seed stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Ethan Blagg, whose prior experience includes co-founding and leading Nexus Technologies. The valuation universe comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers, including SpaceX, Sierra Space, Planet Labs, Impulse Space, and Apex Space.

Standard triangulation methods were applied with limited success. Peer-median analysis is not applicable: while 11 same-sector peers exist in Space & Aerospace, none satisfy the narrow filters required (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier matches); a minimum of 3 datapoints is needed to defensibly anchor on sector median, and filtering to pre-seed or near-stage equivalents yielded zero results. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied because Dynamo Air's revenue is not on file—a typical limitation for private companies at this stage. The Space & Aerospace public median P/S is 23.9x across 6 tickers, but revenue disclosure is required to use this multiple.

No quantitative valuation range can be supported without either disclosed revenue figures or a sufficient cohort of pre-seed Space & Aerospace comparables with known valuations. The analysis is constrained by data availability rather than methodology. Key uncertainties center on product maturity, capital requirements to next milestone, and founder track record translation to this new venture. Additional information on Dynamo Air's near-term revenue potential or comparable pre-seed fundraising rounds in propulsion or launch infrastructure would be necessary to establish a defensible valuation.
